calendar_intro: Releases on the radar — cinema, digital, and streaming windows.
calendar_load_failed: Couldn't load releases for this month.
cast_none_help: Cast appears once TMDB credits are fetched for this title.

cf_conditions_help: Every required condition must pass. When a condition isn't required, at least one of those must pass too.

dlclients_empty_help: Add a qBittorrent, Transmission, or Deluge instance to receive grabs.

imports_already_matched_show: This show is already matched to a library entry. Committing links it to that show.

imports_commit_note_hardlink: Confirmed entries will be hard-linked into the library.

imports_commit_short_hardlink: Will be hard-linked into the library

imports_exclude_show: Exclude this show from the import

imports_one_per_show: One entry per show folder, matched against TVDB.

imports_path_help: Absolute path on the server, e.g. /data/movies/incoming.

imports_pick_tvdb: Pick a TVDB match for this folder

imports_restore_show: Restore this show to the import

indexer_apikey_keep: Leave blank to keep the existing API key.

indexers_empty_help: Add at least one Torznab indexer to start searching for releases.

lookup_pick_result: Pick a result to see its synopsis, cast and IDs.

mediaserver_section_help: Click Discover to enumerate sections, or enter a section key
mediaserver_token_keep: Leave blank to keep the existing token/API key.
mediaserver_url_help: Full base URL including scheme and port.
migration_download_note: Download data belongs to the download client, so it is never moved for you. Remap the client's own volume first, then re-point the records here.
migration_intro: Moved your media to a new mount or remapped a volume? This rewrites every stored path under the old root so it points at the new one, and updates the configured root to match.
migration_move_files_help: Off, the files are expected to already be at the new path and only the database is updated. On, each file is relocated first — instant on the same filesystem, a full copy across different ones.
migration_no_undo: There is no undo — running the migration in reverse is how you go back.
migration_nothing_stored: Nothing is stored under that prefix — check the current prefix.
migration_readonly_note: This instance is read-only, so the configured root is left untouched — edit it where the config lives. The stored paths are still rewritten.
movies_available_after_import: Available after the movie has been imported
movies_empty_help: Add a movie from TMDB or import what you already have on disk to get started.
movies_try_other_tab: Try a different tab or clear the search to see your full library.
movies_type_2_chars: Type at least 2 characters to find a movie.
oidc_issuer_help: Discovery document is fetched from this URL on save.

palette_placeholder: Search movies & series, run actions, jump anywhere…

probe_verification_help: What happens when a finished download disagrees with its release name.

quality_preferred_help: Releases at this resolution score highest.
quality_upgrades_help: Re-grab when a higher-quality release becomes available.

series_packs_hidden: Complete and multi-season packs are hidden in a season search — switch to
series_specials_help: Season 0 holds recaps, OVAs and behind-the-scenes extras. Left off, a new series arrives with its specials unmonitored — nothing is searched or grabbed for them until you turn the season on.
series_specials_switch: Switches season 0 on for every monitored series already in the library.
series_specials_switch_off: Switches season 0 off for every series already in the library.
series_type_2_chars: Type at least 2 characters to find a show.

settings_general_intro: A snapshot of how Streamline is running. These values are read-only — edit your config file to change them.
settings_media_probe_intro: Read technical detail from files with ffprobe, and check a download against what the release claimed.

settings_oidc_role_help: Assigned to new users created via OIDC when registration is open.

settings_series_intro: How new series and seasons enter the library. Changes take effect immediately — no restart required.

torrent_click_change_file: Click to choose a different file
torrent_dht_only: This torrent relies on DHT / peer exchange only.
